blocks.label: section_header
blocks.text: 3. Prepare the dose:
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text: Take the cap off the top of the vial (see figure 3).
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: 合
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: caption
blocks.text: Figure 3
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text: Do not remove the stopper.
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text: Clean the stopper with an antiseptic swab.
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text: Put the vial on a flat surface.
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text: Pick up the syringe and remove the needle cover.
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text: Do not touch the needle or let the needle touch anything.
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text: Push the needle through the rubber stopper.
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text: Turn the vial and the syringe upside down.
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text: Pull on the syringe plunger to fill the syringe with the amount of liquid prescribed by your doctor.
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text: It is important that the needle is always in the liquid. This stops air bubbles forming in the syringe (see figure 4).
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.caption: Figure 4
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: caption
blocks.text: Figure 4
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text: Remove the needle from the vial.
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text: Hold the syringe with the needle pointing up to see if it has any air bubbles inside.
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text: If there are air bubbles, tap the side gently until the air bubbles go to the top of the syringe (see figure 5).
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text: Then press the plunger until all of the air (but none of the liquid) has been removed.
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text: Do not lay the syringe down or allow the needle to touch anything.
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.caption: Figure 5
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: caption
blocks.text: Figure 5
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: section_header
blocks.text: 4. Inject the dose:
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text: Gently pinch the cleaned skin between your thumb and index finger. Do not squeeze it tightly.
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text: Push the needle into the pinched skin at a 45-degree angle.
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text: Push the plunger with your thumb as far as it will go to inject all of the liquid. Push it slowly and evenly, keeping the skin gently pinched.
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text: When the plunger is pushed as far as it will go, take out the needle and let go of the skin.
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: section_header
blocks.text: 5. After the injection:
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text: Press an antiseptic wipe over the injection site for a few seconds after the injection.
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text: There may be a small amount of blood or liquid at the injection site. This is normal.
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text: You can press a cotton ball or gauze over the injection site and hold for 10 seconds.
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text: Do not rub the skin at the injection site. You may cover the injection site with a small adhesive bandage, if necessary.
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: section_header
blocks.text: 6. Disposal:
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text: Used syringes and needles should be placed in a puncture-resistant container, like a sharps container. Never re-use needles and syringes, for your safety and health, and for the safety of others. Dispose of your sharps container according to your local regulations.
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text: Empty vials, antiseptic wipes, and other supplies can be disposed of in your garbage.
blocks.speaker: label

section_path: 1. What WEZENLA is and what it is used for
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: WEZENLA contains the active substance 'ustekinumab', a monoclonal antibody. Monoclonal antibodies are proteins that recognise and bind specifically to certain proteins in the body.
section_path: 1. What WEZENLA is and what it is used for
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: WEZENLA belongs to a group of medicines called 'immunosuppressants'. These medicines work by weakening part of the immune system.
section_path: 1. What WEZENLA is and what it is used for
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: section_header
blocks.text: What WEZENLA is used for
section_path: 1. What WEZENLA is and what it is used for
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: WEZENLA is used to treat the following inflammatory diseases:
section_path: 1. What WEZENLA is and what it is used for
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: section_header
blocks.text: Plaque psoriasis
section_path: 1. What WEZENLA is and what it is used for
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: Plaque psoriasis is a skin condition that causes inflammation affecting the skin and nails. WEZENLA will reduce the inflammation and other signs of the disease.
section_path: 1. What WEZENLA is and what it is used for
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: WEZENLA is used in adults with moderate to severe plaque psoriasis, who cannot use ciclosporin, methotrexate or phototherapy, or where these treatments did not work.
section_path: 1. What WEZENLA is and what it is used for
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: WEZENLA is used in children and adolescents aged 6 years and older with moderate to severe plaque psoriasis who are unable to tolerate phototherapy or other systemic therapies or where these treatments did not work.
section_path: 1. What WEZENLA is and what it is used for
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: section_header
blocks.text: Psoriatic arthritis
section_path: 1. What WEZENLA is and what it is used for
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: Psoriatic arthritis is an inflammatory disease of the joints, usually accompanied by psoriasis. If you have active psoriatic arthritis you will first be given other medicines. If you do not respond well enough to these medicines, you may be given WEZENLA to:
section_path: 1. What WEZENLA is and what it is used for
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text: Reduce the signs and symptoms of your disease.
section_path: 1. What WEZENLA is and what it is used for
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text: Improve your physical function.
section_path: 1. What WEZENLA is and what it is used for
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text: Slow down the damage to your joints.
section_path: 1. What WEZENLA is and what it is used for
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: section_header
blocks.text: Crohn's disease
section_path: 1. What WEZENLA is and what it is used for
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: Crohn's disease is an inflammatory disease of the bowel. If you have Crohn's disease you will first be given other medicines. If you do not respond well enough or are intolerant to these medicines, you may be given WEZENLA to reduce the signs and symptoms of your disease.
section_path: 1. What WEZENLA is and what it is used for
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: section_header
blocks.text: 2. What you need to know before you use WEZENLA
section_path: 2. What you need to know before you use WEZENLA
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: section_header
blocks.text: Do not use WEZENLA
section_path: 2. What you need to know before you use WEZENLA
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text: If you are allergic to ustekinumab or any of the other ingredients of this medicine (listed in section 6).
section_path: 2. What you need to know before you use WEZENLA
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text: If you have an active infection which your doctor thinks is important.
section_path: 2. What you need to know before you use WEZENLA
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: If you are not sure if any of the above applies to you, talk to your doctor or pharmacist before using WEZENLA.
section_path: 2. What you need to know before you use WEZENLA
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: section_header
blocks.text: Warnings and precautions
section_path: 2. What you need to know before you use WEZENLA
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: Talk to your doctor or pharmacist before using WEZENLA. Your doctor will check how well you are before each treatment. Make sure you tell your doctor about any illness you have before each treatment. Also tell your doctor if you have recently been near anyone who might have tuberculosis. Your doctor will examine you and do a test for tuberculosis, before you have WEZENLA. If your doctor thinks you are at risk of tuberculosis, you may be given medicines to treat it.
section_path: 2. What you need to know before you use WEZENLA
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: section_header
blocks.text: Look out for serious side effects
section_path: 2. What you need to know before you use WEZENLA
Look out for serious side effects
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: WEZENLA can cause serious side effects, including allergic reactions and infections. You must look out for certain signs of illness while you are taking WEZENLA. See 'Serious side effects' in section 4 for a full list of these side effects.
section_path: 2. What you need to know before you use WEZENLA
Look out for serious side effects
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: section_header
blocks.text: Before you use WEZENLA tell your doctor:
section_path: 2. What you need to know before you use WEZENLA
Before you use WEZENLA tell your doctor:
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text: If you ever had an allergic reaction to WEZENLA. Ask your doctor if you are not sure.
section_path: 2. What you need to know before you use WEZENLA
Before you use WEZENLA tell your doctor:
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text: If you have ever had any type of cancer - this is because immunosuppressants like WEZENLA weaken part of the immune system. This may increase the risk of cancer.
section_path: 2. What you need to know before you use WEZENLA
Before you use WEZENLA tell your doctor:
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text: If you have been treated for psoriasis with other biologic medicines (a medicine produced from a biological source and usually given by injection) - the risk of cancer may be higher.
section_path: 2. What you need to know before you use WEZENLA
Before you use WEZENLA tell your doctor:
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text: If you have or have had a recent infection.
section_path: 2. What you need to know before you use WEZENLA
Before you use WEZENLA tell your doctor:
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text: If you have any new or changing lesions within psoriasis areas or on normal skin.
section_path: 2. What you need to know before you use WEZENLA
Before you use WEZENLA tell your doctor:
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text: If you are having any other treatment for psoriasis and/or psoriatic arthritis - such as another immunosuppressant or phototherapy (when your body is treated with a type of ultraviolet (UV) light). These treatments may also weaken part of the immune system. Using these therapies together with WEZENLA has not been studied. However, it is possible it may increase the chance of diseases related to a weaker immune system.
section_path: 2. What you need to know before you use WEZENLA
Before you use WEZENLA tell your doctor:
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text: If you are having or have ever had injections to treat allergies - it is not known if WEZENLA may affect these.
section_path: 2. What you need to know before you use WEZENLA
Before you use WEZENLA tell your doctor:
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text: If you are 65 years of age or over - you may be more likely to get infections.
section_path: 2. What you need to know before you use WEZENLA
Before you use WEZENLA tell your doctor:
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: If you are not sure if any of the above applies to you, talk to your doctor or pharmacist before using WEZENLA.
section_path: 2. What you need to know before you use WEZENLA
Before you use WEZENLA tell your doctor:
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: Some patients have experienced lupus-like reactions including skin lupus or lupus-like syndrome during treatment with ustekinumab. Talk to your doctor right away if you experience a red, raised, scaly rash sometimes with a darker border, in areas of the skin that are exposed to the sun or with joint pains.
section_path: 2. What you need to know before you use WEZENLA
Before you use WEZENLA tell your doctor:
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: section_header
blocks.text: Heart attack and strokes
section_path: 2. What you need to know before you use WEZENLA
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: Heart attack and strokes have been observed in a study in patients with psoriasis treated with ustekinumab. Your doctor will regularly check your risk factors for heart disease and stroke in order to ensure that they are appropriately treated. Seek medical attention right away if you develop chest pain, weakness or abnormal sensation on one side of your body, facial droop, or speech or visual abnormalities.
section_path: 2. What you need to know before you use WEZENLA
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: section_header
blocks.text: Children and adolescents
section_path: 2. What you need to know before you use WEZENLA
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: WEZENLA is not recommended for use in children with psoriasis under 6 years of age, children with Crohn's disease under 2 years of age or for use in children under 18 years of age with psoriatic arthritis, because it has not been studied in these age groups.
section_path: 2. What you need to know before you use WEZENLA
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: section_header
blocks.text: Other medicines, vaccines and WEZENLA
section_path: 2. What you need to know before you use WEZENLA
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: Tell your doctor or pharmacist:
section_path: 2. What you need to know before you use WEZENLA
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text: If you are taking, have recently taken or might take any other medicines.
section_path: 2. What you need to know before you use WEZENLA
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text: If you have recently had or are going to have a vaccination. Some types of vaccines (live vaccines) should not be given while using WEZENLA.
section_path: 2. What you need to know before you use WEZENLA
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text: If you received WEZENLA while pregnant, tell your baby's doctor about your WEZENLA treatment before the baby receives any vaccine, including live vaccines, such as the BCG vaccine (used to prevent tuberculosis). Live vaccines are not recommended for your baby in the first twelve months after birth if you received WEZENLA during the pregnancy unless your baby's doctor recommends otherwise.
section_path: 2. What you need to know before you use WEZENLA
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: section_header
blocks.text: Pregnancy and breast-feeding
section_path: 2. What you need to know before you use WEZENLA
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text: If you are pregnant, think you may be pregnant or are planning to have a baby, ask your doctor for advice before taking this medicine.
section_path: 2. What you need to know before you use WEZENLA
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text: A higher risk of birth defects has not been seen in babies exposed to WEZENLA in the womb. However, there is limited experience with WEZENLA in pregnant women. It is therefore preferable to avoid the use of WEZENLA in pregnancy.
section_path: 2. What you need to know before you use WEZENLA
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text: If you are a woman of childbearing potential, you are advised to avoid becoming pregnant and must use adequate contraception while using WEZENLA and for at least 15 weeks after the last WEZENLA treatment.
section_path: 2. What you need to know before you use WEZENLA
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text: WEZENLA can pass across the placenta to the unborn baby. If you received WEZENLA during your pregnancy, your baby may have a higher risk for getting an infection.
section_path: 2. What you need to know before you use WEZENLA
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text: It is important that you tell your baby's doctors and other health care professionals if you received WEZENLA during your pregnancy before the baby receives any vaccine. Live vaccines such as the BCG vaccine (used to prevent tuberculosis) are not recommended for your baby in the first twelve months after birth if you received WEZENLA during the pregnancy unless your baby's doctor recommends otherwise.
section_path: 2. What you need to know before you use WEZENLA
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text: Ustekinumab may pass into breast milk in very small amounts. Talk to your doctor if you are breast-feeding or are planning to breast-feed. You and your doctor should decide if you should breast-feed or use WEZENLA - do not do both.
section_path: 2. What you need to know before you use WEZENLA
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: section_header
blocks.text: Driving and using machines
section_path: 2. What you need to know before you use WEZENLA
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: WEZENLA has no or negligible influence on the ability to drive and use machines.
section_path: 2. What you need to know before you use WEZENLA
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: section_header
blocks.text: WEZENLA contains polysorbate 80
section_path: 2. What you need to know before you use WEZENLA
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: WEZENLA contains 0.02 mg (45 mg/0.5 mL) or 0.04 mg (90 mg/1.0 mL) of polysorbate 80 (E 433) in each dosage unit which is equivalent to 0.04 mg/mL. Polysorbates may cause allergic reactions. Tell your doctor if you have any known allergies.
section_path: 2. What you need to know before you use WEZENLA
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: section_header
blocks.text: 3. How to use WEZENLA
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: WEZENLA is intended for use under the guidance and supervision of a doctor experienced in treating conditions for which WEZENLA is intended.
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: Always use this medicine exactly as your doctor has told you. Check with your doctor if you are not sure. Talk to your doctor about when you will have your injections and follow-up appointments.
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: section_header
blocks.text: How much WEZENLA is given
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: Your doctor will decide how much WEZENLA you need to use and for how long.
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: section_header
blocks.text: Adults aged 18 years or older Psoriasis or Psoriatic Arthritis
section_path: Adults aged 18 years or older Psoriasis or Psoriatic Arthritis
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text: The recommended starting dose is 45 mg WEZENLA. Patients who weigh more than 100 kilograms (kg) may start on a dose of 90 mg instead of 45 mg.
section_path: Adults aged 18 years or older Psoriasis or Psoriatic Arthritis
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text: After the starting dose, you will have the next dose 4 weeks later, and then every 12 weeks. The following doses are usually the same as the starting dose.
section_path: Adults aged 18 years or older Psoriasis or Psoriatic Arthritis
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: section_header
blocks.text: Crohn's disease
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text: During treatment, the first dose of approximately 6 mg/kg WEZENLA will be given by your doctor through a drip in a vein in your arm (intravenous infusion). After the starting dose, you will receive the next dose of 90 mg WEZENLA after 8 weeks, then every 12 weeks thereafter by an injection under the skin ('subcutaneously').
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text: In some patients, after the first injection under the skin, 90 mg WEZENLA may be given every 8 weeks. Your doctor will decide when you should receive your next dose.
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: section_header
blocks.text: Children and adolescents aged 6 years or older Psoriasis
section_path: Children and adolescents aged 6 years or older Psoriasis
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text: The doctor will work out the right dose for you, including the amount (volume) of WEZENLA to be injected to give the right dose. The right dose for you will depend on your body weight at the time each dose is given.
section_path: Children and adolescents aged 6 years or older Psoriasis
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text: A 45 mg vial is available for children who need to receive less than the full 45 mg dose.
section_path: Children and adolescents aged 6 years or older Psoriasis
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text: If you weigh less than 60 kg, the recommended dose is 0.75 mg of WEZENLA per kg body weight.
section_path: Children and adolescents aged 6 years or older Psoriasis
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text: If you weigh 60 kg to 100 kg, the recommended dose is 45 mg WEZENLA.
section_path: Children and adolescents aged 6 years or older Psoriasis
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text: If you weigh more than 100 kg, the recommended dose is 90 mg WEZENLA.
section_path: Children and adolescents aged 6 years or older Psoriasis
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text: After the starting dose, you will have the next dose 4 weeks later, and then every 12 weeks.
section_path: Children and adolescents aged 6 years or older Psoriasis
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: section_header
blocks.text: Children who weigh less than 40 kg Crohn's disease
section_path: Children who weigh less than 40 kg Crohn's disease
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text: During treatment, your doctor will work out the recommended intravenous infusion dose for you based on your body surface area (BSA). This will be given by your doctor through a drip in a vein in your arm (intravenous infusion). After the starting dose, your doctor will work out the next dose based on your BSA. You will receive this dose of WEZENLA after 8 weeks, then every 12 weeks thereafter by an injection under the skin ('subcutaneously').
section_path: Children who weigh less than 40 kg Crohn's disease
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text: In some patients, after the first injection under the skin, WEZENLA may be given every 8 weeks or every 4 weeks. Your doctor will decide when you should receive your next dose.
section_path: Children who weigh less than 40 kg Crohn's disease
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: section_header
blocks.text: Children who weigh at least 40 kg
section_path: Children who weigh at least 40 kg
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: section_header
blocks.text: Crohn's disease
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text: During treatment, the first dose of approximately 6 mg/kg WEZENLA will be given by your doctor through a drip in a vein in your arm (intravenous infusion). After the starting dose, you will receive the next dose of 90 mg WEZENLA after 8 weeks, then every 12 weeks thereafter by an injection under the skin ('subcutaneously').
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text: In some patients, after the first injection under the skin, 90 mg WEZENLA may be given every 8 weeks or every 4 weeks. Your doctor will decide when you should receive your next dose.
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: section_header
blocks.text: How WEZENLA is given
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text: WEZENLA is given as an injection under the skin ('subcutaneously'). At the start of your treatment, medical or nursing staff may inject WEZENLA.
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text: However, you and your doctor may decide that you may inject WEZENLA yourself. In this case you will get training on how to inject WEZENLA yourself.
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text: For instructions on how to inject WEZENLA, see 'Instructions for use' at the end of this leaflet. Talk to your doctor if you have any questions about giving yourself an injection.
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: section_header
blocks.text: If you use more WEZENLA than you should
section_path: If you use more WEZENLA than you should
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: If you have used or been given too much WEZENLA, talk to a doctor or pharmacist straight away. Always have the outer carton of the medicine with you, even if it is empty.
section_path: If you use more WEZENLA than you should
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: section_header
blocks.text: If you forget to use WEZENLA
section_path: If you forget to use WEZENLA
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: If you forget a dose, contact your doctor or pharmacist. Do not take a double dose to make up for a forgotten dose.
section_path: If you forget to use WEZENLA
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: section_header
blocks.text: If you stop using WEZENLA
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: It is not dangerous to stop using WEZENLA. However, if you stop, your symptoms may come back.
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: If you have any further questions on the use of this medicine, ask your doctor or pharmacist.
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: section_header
blocks.text: 4. Possible side effects
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: Like all medicines, this medicine can cause side effects, although not everybody gets them.
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: section_header
blocks.text: Serious side effects
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: Some patients may have serious side effects that may need urgent treatment.
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: section_header
blocks.text: Allergic reactions - these may need urgent treatment. Tell your doctor or get emergency medical help straight away if you notice any of the following signs.
section_path: Allergic reactions - these may need urgent treatment. Tell your doctor or get emergency medical help straight away if you notice any of the following signs.
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text: Serious allergic reactions ('anaphylaxis') are rare in people taking ustekinumab (may affect up to 1 in 1 000 people). Signs include:
section_path: Allergic reactions - these may need urgent treatment. Tell your doctor or get emergency medical help straight away if you notice any of the following signs.
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text: difficulty breathing or swallowing
section_path: Allergic reactions - these may need urgent treatment. Tell your doctor or get emergency medical help straight away if you notice any of the following signs.
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text: low blood pressure, which can cause dizziness or light-headedness
section_path: Allergic reactions - these may need urgent treatment. Tell your doctor or get emergency medical help straight away if you notice any of the following signs.
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text: swelling of the face, lips, mouth or throat.
section_path: Allergic reactions - these may need urgent treatment. Tell your doctor or get emergency medical help straight away if you notice any of the following signs.
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text: Common signs of an allergic reaction include skin rash and hives (these may affect up to 1 in 100 people).
section_path: Allergic reactions - these may need urgent treatment. Tell your doctor or get emergency medical help straight away if you notice any of the following signs.
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: In rare cases, allergic lung reactions and lung inflammation have been reported in patients who receive ustekinumab. Tell your doctor right away if you develop symptoms such as cough, shortness of breath, and fever.
section_path: Allergic reactions - these may need urgent treatment. Tell your doctor or get emergency medical help straight away if you notice any of the following signs.
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: If you have a serious allergic reaction, your doctor may decide that you should not use WEZENLA again.
section_path: Allergic reactions - these may need urgent treatment. Tell your doctor or get emergency medical help straight away if you notice any of the following signs.
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: section_header
blocks.text: Infections - these may need urgent treatment. Tell your doctor straight away if you notice any of the following signs.
section_path: Infections - these may need urgent treatment. Tell your doctor straight away if you notice any of the following signs.
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text: Infections of the nose or throat and common cold are common (may affect up to 1 in 10 people)
section_path: Infections - these may need urgent treatment. Tell your doctor straight away if you notice any of the following signs.
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text: Infections of the chest are uncommon (may affect up to 1 in 100 people)
section_path: Infections - these may need urgent treatment. Tell your doctor straight away if you notice any of the following signs.
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text: Inflammation of tissue under the skin ('cellulitis') is uncommon (may affect up to 1 in 100 people)
section_path: Infections - these may need urgent treatment. Tell your doctor straight away if you notice any of the following signs.
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text: Shingles (a type of painful rash with blisters) are uncommon (may affect up to 1 in 100 people)
section_path: Infections - these may need urgent treatment. Tell your doctor straight away if you notice any of the following signs.
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: WEZENLA may make you less able to fight infections. Some infections could become serious and may include infections caused by viruses, fungi, bacteria (including tuberculosis), or parasites, including infections that mainly occur in people with a weakened immune system (opportunistic infections). Opportunistic infections of the brain (encephalitis, meningitis), lungs, and eye have been reported in patients receiving treatment with ustekinumab.
section_path: Infections - these may need urgent treatment. Tell your doctor straight away if you notice any of the following signs.
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: You must look out for signs of infection while you are using WEZENLA. These include:
section_path: Infections - these may need urgent treatment. Tell your doctor straight away if you notice any of the following signs.
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text: fever, flu-like symptoms, night sweats, weight loss
section_path: Infections - these may need urgent treatment. Tell your doctor straight away if you notice any of the following signs.
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text: feeling tired or short of breath; cough which will not go away
section_path: Infections - these may need urgent treatment. Tell your doctor straight away if you notice any of the following signs.
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text: warm, red and painful skin, or a painful skin rash with blisters
section_path: Infections - these may need urgent treatment. Tell your doctor straight away if you notice any of the following signs.
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text: burning when passing water
section_path: Infections - these may need urgent treatment. Tell your doctor straight away if you notice any of the following signs.
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text: diarrhoea
section_path: Infections - these may need urgent treatment. Tell your doctor straight away if you notice any of the following signs.
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text: visual disturbance or vision loss
section_path: Infections - these may need urgent treatment. Tell your doctor straight away if you notice any of the following signs.
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text: headache, neck stiffness, light sensitivity, nausea or confusion.
section_path: Infections - these may need urgent treatment. Tell your doctor straight away if you notice any of the following signs.
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: Tell your doctor straight away if you notice any of these signs of infection. These may be signs of infections such as chest infections, skin infections, shingles or opportunistic infections that could have serious complications. Tell your doctor if you have any kind of infection that will not go away or keeps coming back. Your doctor may decide that you should not use WEZENLA until the infection goes away. Also tell your doctor if you have any open cuts or sores as they might get infected.
section_path: Infections - these may need urgent treatment. Tell your doctor straight away if you notice any of the following signs.
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: Shedding of skin - increase in redness and shedding of skin over a larger area of the body may be symptoms of erythrodermic psoriasis or exfoliative dermatitis, which are serious skin conditions. You should tell your doctor straight away if you notice any of these signs.
section_path: Infections - these may need urgent treatment. Tell your doctor straight away if you notice any of the following signs.
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: section_header
blocks.text: Other side effects
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: Common side effects (may affect up to 1 in 10 people):
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text: Diarrhoea
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text: Nausea
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text: Vomiting
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text: Feeling tired
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text: Feeling dizzy
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text: Headache
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text: Itching ('pruritus')
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text: Back, muscle or joint pain
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text: Sore throat
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text: Redness and pain where the injection is given
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text: Sinus infection
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: Uncommon side effects (may affect up to 1 in 100 people):
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text: Tooth infections
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text: Vaginal yeast infection
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text: Depression
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text: Blocked or stuffy nose
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text: Bleeding, bruising, hardness, swelling and itching where the injection is given
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text: Feeling weak
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text: Drooping eyelid and sagging muscles on one side of the face ('facial palsy' or 'Bell's palsy'), which is usually temporary
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text: A change in psoriasis with redness and new tiny, yellow or white skin blisters, sometimes accompanied by fever (pustular psoriasis)
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text: Peeling of the skin (skin exfoliation)
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text: Acne
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: Rare side effects (may affect up to 1 in 1 000 people):
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text: Redness and shedding of skin over a larger area of the body, which may be itchy or painful (exfoliative dermatitis). Similar symptoms sometimes develop as a natural change in the type of psoriasis symptoms (erythrodermic psoriasis)
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text: Inflammation of small blood vessels, which can lead to a skin rash with small red or purple bumps, fever or joint pain (vasculitis)
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: Very rare side effects (may affect up to 1 in 10 000 people):
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text: Blistering of the skin that may be red, itchy, and painful (Bullous pemphigoid)
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text: Skin lupus or lupus-like syndrome (red, raised scaly rash on areas of the skin exposed to the sun possibly with joint pains).
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: section_header
blocks.text: Reporting of side effects
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: If you get any side effects, talk to your doctor or pharmacist. This includes any possible side effects not listed in this leaflet. You can also report side effects directly via the national reporting system listed in Appendix V. By reporting side effects you can help provide more information on the safety of this medicine.
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: section_header
blocks.text: 5. How to store WEZENLA
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text: Keep this medicine out of the sight and reach of children.
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text: Store in a refrigerator (2°C-8°C). Do not freeze.
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text: Keep the pre-filled syringe in the outer carton in order to protect from light.
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text: If needed, individual WEZENLA pre-filled syringes may also be stored at room temperature up to 30°C for a maximum single period of up to 30 days in the original carton in order to protect from light. Record the date when the pre-filled syringe is first removed from the refrigerator and the discard date. The discard date must not exceed the original expiry date printed on the carton. Once a syringe has been stored at room temperature (up to 30°C), it should not be returned to the refrigerator. Discard the syringe if not used within 30 days at room temperature storage or by the original expiry date, whichever is earlier.
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text: Do not shake WEZENLA pre-filled syringes. Prolonged vigorous shaking may damage the medicine.
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: section_header
blocks.text: Do not use this medicine:
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text: After the expiry date which is stated on the label and the carton after 'EXP'. The expiry date refers to the last day of that month.
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text: If the liquid is discoloured, cloudy or you can see foreign particles floating in it (see section 6 'What WEZENLA looks like and contents of the pack').
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text: If you know, or think that it may have been exposed to extreme temperatures (such as accidentally frozen or heated).
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text: If the product has been shaken vigorously.
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: WEZENLA is for single use only. Any unused product remaining in the syringe should be thrown away. Do not throw away any medicines via wastewater or household waste. Ask your pharmacist how to throw away medicines you no longer use. These measures will help protect the environment.
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.text: What WEZENLA contains
section_path: 6. Contents of the pack and other information

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text: The active substance is ustekinumab. Each pre-filled syringe contains 45 mg ustekinumab in 0.5 mL or 90 mg ustekinumab in 1 mL.
section_path: 6. Contents of the pack and other information
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text: The other ingredients are L-histidine, L-histidine hydrochloride monohydrate, polysorbate 80 (E 433), sucrose and water for injections.

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: WEZENLA is a clear to opalescent, colourless to light yellow solution for injection. It is supplied as a carton pack containing 1 single-dose, glass 1 mL pre-filled syringe. Each pre-filled syringe contains 45 mg ustekinumab in 0.5 mL or 90 mg ustekinumab in 1 mL of solution for injection.

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text: WEZENLA comes in two different doses: 45 mg/0.5 mL and 90 mg/1.0 mL. Check your prescription to make sure you have the correct dose.

blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text: The look of the pre-filled syringe will be different for each dose. The amount of medicine in the pre-filled syringe will also be different for each dose.

blocks.text: The 45 mg/0.5 mL dose has a smaller amount of medicine than the 90 mg/1.0 mL. Check the illustrations below to see what your dose looks like in the pre-filled syringe.

blocks.text: Using your WEZENLA pre-filled syringe:

blocks.text: It is important that you do not try to give yourself the injection unless you have received training from your doctor or healthcare provider.

blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text: In children 12 years of age and older with psoriasis who weigh 60 kg or more, it is recommended that WEZENLA is used by or under supervision of a parent or caregiver.

blocks.text: Do not use the pre-filled syringe if the carton is damaged or seal is broken.

blocks.label: section_header
blocks.text: What WEZENLA is
section_path: 1. What WEZENLA is and what it is used for
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: WEZENLA contains the active substance 'ustekinumab', a monoclonal antibody. Monoclonal antibodies are proteins that recognise and bind specifically to certain proteins in the body.
section_path: 1. What WEZENLA is and what it is used for
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: WEZENLA belongs to a group of medicines called 'immunosuppressants'. These medicines work by weakening part of the immune system.
section_path: 1. What WEZENLA is and what it is used for
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: section_header
blocks.text: What WEZENLA is used for
section_path: 1. What WEZENLA is and what it is used for
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: WEZENLA is used to treat the following inflammatory diseases:
section_path: 1. What WEZENLA is and what it is used for
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text: Plaque psoriasis - in adults
section_path: 1. What WEZENLA is and what it is used for
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text: Psoriatic arthritis - in adults
section_path: 1. What WEZENLA is and what it is used for
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text: Moderate to severe Crohn's disease - in adults
section_path: 1. What WEZENLA is and what it is used for
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: section_header
blocks.text: Plaque psoriasis
section_path: 1. What WEZENLA is and what it is used for
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: Plaque psoriasis is a skin condition that causes inflammation affecting the skin and nails. WEZENLA will reduce the inflammation and other signs of the disease.
section_path: 1. What WEZENLA is and what it is used for
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: WEZENLA is used in adults with moderate to severe plaque psoriasis, who cannot use ciclosporin, methotrexate or phototherapy, or where these treatments did not work.
section_path: 1. What WEZENLA is and what it is used for
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: section_header
blocks.text: Psoriatic arthritis
section_path: 1. What WEZENLA is and what it is used for
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: Psoriatic arthritis is an inflammatory disease of the joints, usually accompanied by psoriasis. If you have active psoriatic arthritis you will first be given other medicines. If you do not respond well enough to these medicines, you may be given WEZENLA to:
section_path: 1. What WEZENLA is and what it is used for
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text: Reduce the signs and symptoms of your disease.
section_path: 1. What WEZENLA is and what it is used for
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text: Improve your physical function.
section_path: 1. What WEZENLA is and what it is used for
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text: Slow down the damage to your joints.
section_path: 1. What WEZENLA is and what it is used for
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: section_header
blocks.text: Crohn's disease
section_path: 1. What WEZENLA is and what it is used for
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: Crohn's disease is an inflammatory disease of the bowel. If you have Crohn's disease you will first be given other medicines. If you do not respond well enough or are intolerant to these medicines, you may be given WEZENLA to reduce the signs and symptoms of your disease.
section_path: 1. What WEZENLA is and what it is used for
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.text: 2. What you need to know before you use WEZENLA
section_path: 2. What you need to know before you use WEZENLA
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: section_header
blocks.text: Do not use WEZENLA
section_path: 2. What you need to know before you use WEZENLA
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text: If you are allergic to ustekinumab or any of the other ingredients of this medicine (listed in section 6).
section_path: 2. What you need to know before you use WEZENLA
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text: If you have an active infection which your doctor thinks is important.
section_path: 2. What you need to know before you use WEZENLA
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: If you are not sure if any of the above applies to you, talk to your doctor or pharmacist before using WEZENLA.
section_path: 2. What you need to know before you use WEZENLA
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: section_header
blocks.text: Warnings and precautions
section_path: 2. What you need to know before you use WEZENLA
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: Talk to your doctor or pharmacist before using WEZENLA. Your doctor will check how well you are before each treatment. Make sure you tell your doctor about any illness you have before each treatment. Also tell your doctor if you have recently been near anyone who might have tuberculosis. Your doctor will examine you and do a test for tuberculosis, before you have WEZENLA. If your doctor thinks you are at risk of tuberculosis, you may be given medicines to treat it.
section_path: 2. What you need to know before you use WEZENLA
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: section_header
blocks.text: Look out for serious side effects
section_path: 2. What you need to know before you use WEZENLA
Look out for serious side effects
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: WEZENLA can cause serious side effects, including allergic reactions and infections. You must look out for certain signs of illness while you are taking WEZENLA. See 'Serious side effects' in section 4 for a full list of these side effects.
section_path: 2. What you need to know before you use WEZENLA
Look out for serious side effects
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: section_header
blocks.text: Before you use WEZENLA tell your doctor:
section_path: 2. What you need to know before you use WEZENLA
Before you use WEZENLA tell your doctor:
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text: If you ever had an allergic reaction to WEZENLA. Ask your doctor if you are not sure.
section_path: 2. What you need to know before you use WEZENLA
Before you use WEZENLA tell your doctor:
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text: If you have ever had any type of cancer - this is because immunosuppressants like WEZENLA weaken part of the immune system. This may increase the risk of cancer.
section_path: 2. What you need to know before you use WEZENLA
Before you use WEZENLA tell your doctor:
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text: If you have been treated for psoriasis with other biologic medicines (a medicine produced from a biological source and usually given by injection) - the risk of cancer may be higher.
section_path: 2. What you need to know before you use WEZENLA
Before you use WEZENLA tell your doctor:
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text: If you have or have had a recent infection.
section_path: 2. What you need to know before you use WEZENLA
Before you use WEZENLA tell your doctor:
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text: If you have any new or changing lesions within psoriasis areas or on normal skin.
section_path: 2. What you need to know before you use WEZENLA
Before you use WEZENLA tell your doctor:
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text: If you are having any other treatment for psoriasis and/or psoriatic arthritis - such as another immunosuppressant or phototherapy (when your body is treated with a type of ultraviolet (UV) light). These treatments may also weaken part of the immune system. Using these therapies together with WEZENLA has not been studied. However, it is possible it may increase the chance of diseases related to a weaker immune system.
section_path: 2. What you need to know before you use WEZENLA
Before you use WEZENLA tell your doctor:
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text: If you are having or have ever had injections to treat allergies - it is not known if WEZENLA may affect these.
section_path: 2. What you need to know before you use WEZENLA
Before you use WEZENLA tell your doctor:
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text: If you are 65 years of age or over - you may be more likely to get infections.
section_path: 2. What you need to know before you use WEZENLA
Before you use WEZENLA tell your doctor:
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: If you are not sure if any of the above applies to you, talk to your doctor or pharmacist before using WEZENLA.
section_path: 2. What you need to know before you use WEZENLA
Before you use WEZENLA tell your doctor:
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: Some patients have experienced lupus-like reactions including skin lupus or lupus-like syndrome during treatment with ustekinumab. Talk to your doctor right away if you experience a red, raised, scaly rash sometimes with a darker border, in areas of the skin that are exposed to the sun or with joint pains.
section_path: 2. What you need to know before you use WEZENLA
Before you use WEZENLA tell your doctor:
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: section_header
blocks.text: Heart attack and strokes
section_path: 2. What you need to know before you use WEZENLA
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: Heart attack and strokes have been observed in a study in patients with psoriasis treated with ustekinumab. Your doctor will regularly check your risk factors for heart disease and stroke in order to ensure that they are appropriately treated. Seek medical attention right away if you develop chest pain, weakness or abnormal sensation on one side of your body, facial droop, or speech or visual abnormalities.
section_path: 2. What you need to know before you use WEZENLA
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: section_header
blocks.text: Children and adolescents
section_path: 2. What you need to know before you use WEZENLA
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: The WEZENLA pre-filled pen is not recommended for use in children and adolescents under 18 years of age with psoriasis or Crohn's disease because it has not been studied in this age group. The prefilled syringe or vial should be used instead for children 6 years of age and older and adolescents with psoriasis. The solution for infusion, pre-filled vial or syringe should be used instead for children 2 years of age and older with Crohn's disease.
section_path: 2. What you need to know before you use WEZENLA
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: WEZENLA is not recommended for use in children and adolescents under 18 years of age with psoriatic arthritis or children with Crohn's disease under 2 years of age because it has not been studied in these age groups.
section_path: 2. What you need to know before you use WEZENLA
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: section_header
blocks.text: Other medicines, vaccines and WEZENLA
section_path: 2. What you need to know before you use WEZENLA
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: Tell your doctor or pharmacist:
section_path: 2. What you need to know before you use WEZENLA
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text: If you are taking, have recently taken or might take any other medicines.
section_path: 2. What you need to know before you use WEZENLA
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text: If you have recently had or are going to have a vaccination. Some types of vaccines (live vaccines) should not be given while using WEZENLA.
section_path: 2. What you need to know before you use WEZENLA
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text: If you received WEZENLA while pregnant, tell your baby's doctor about your WEZENLA treatment before the baby receives any vaccine, including live vaccines, such as the BCG vaccine (used to prevent tuberculosis). Live vaccines are not recommended for your baby in the first twelve months after birth if you received WEZENLA during the pregnancy unless your baby's doctor recommends otherwise.
section_path: 2. What you need to know before you use WEZENLA
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: section_header
blocks.text: Pregnancy and breast-feeding
section_path: 2. What you need to know before you use WEZENLA
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text: If you are pregnant, think you may be pregnant or are planning to have a baby, ask your doctor for advice before taking this medicine.
section_path: 2. What you need to know before you use WEZENLA
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text: A higher risk of birth defects has not been seen in babies exposed to WEZENLA in the womb. However, there is limited experience with WEZENLA in pregnant women. It is therefore preferable to avoid the use of WEZENLA in pregnancy.
section_path: 2. What you need to know before you use WEZENLA
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text: If you are a woman of childbearing potential, you are advised to avoid becoming pregnant and must use adequate contraception while using WEZENLA and for at least 15 weeks after the last WEZENLA treatment.
section_path: 2. What you need to know before you use WEZENLA
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text: WEZENLA can pass across the placenta to the unborn baby. If you received WEZENLA during your pregnancy, your baby may have a higher risk for getting an infection.
section_path: 2. What you need to know before you use WEZENLA
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text: It is important that you tell your baby's doctors and other health care professionals if you received WEZENLA during your pregnancy before the baby receives any vaccine. Live vaccines such as the BCG vaccine (used to prevent tuberculosis) are not recommended for your baby in the first twelve months after birth if you received WEZENLA during the pregnancy unless your baby's doctor recommends otherwise.
section_path: 2. What you need to know before you use WEZENLA
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text: Ustekinumab may pass into breast milk in very small amounts. Talk to your doctor if you are breast-feeding or are planning to breast-feed. You and your doctor should decide if you should breast-feed or use WEZENLA - do not do both.
section_path: 2. What you need to know before you use WEZENLA
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: section_header
blocks.text: Driving and using machines
section_path: 2. What you need to know before you use WEZENLA
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: WEZENLA has no or negligible influence on the ability to drive and use machines.
section_path: 2. What you need to know before you use WEZENLA
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: section_header
blocks.text: WEZENLA contains polysorbate 80
section_path: 2. What you need to know before you use WEZENLA
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: WEZENLA contains 0.02 mg (45 mg/0.5 mL) or 0.04 mg (90 mg/1.0 mL) of polysorbate 80 (E 433) in each dosage unit which is equivalent to 0.04 mg/mL. Polysorbates may cause allergic reactions. Tell your doctor if you have any known allergies.
section_path: 2. What you need to know before you use WEZENLA
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: section_header
blocks.text: 3. How to use WEZENLA
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: WEZENLA is intended for use under the guidance and supervision of a doctor experienced in treating conditions for which WEZENLA is intended.
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: Always use this medicine exactly as your doctor has told you. Check with your doctor if you are not sure. Talk to your doctor about when you will have your injections and follow-up appointments.
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: section_header
blocks.text: How much WEZENLA is given
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: Your doctor will decide how much WEZENLA you need to use and for how long.
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: section_header
blocks.text: Adults aged 18 years or older Psoriasis or psoriatic arthritis
section_path: Adults aged 18 years or older Psoriasis or psoriatic arthritis
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text: The recommended starting dose is 45 mg WEZENLA. Patients who weigh more than 100 kilograms (kg) may start on a dose of 90 mg instead of 45 mg.
section_path: Adults aged 18 years or older Psoriasis or psoriatic arthritis
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text: After the starting dose, you will have the next dose 4 weeks later, and then every 12 weeks. The following doses are usually the same as the starting dose.
section_path: Adults aged 18 years or older Psoriasis or psoriatic arthritis
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: section_header
blocks.text: Crohn's disease
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text: During treatment, the first dose of approximately 6 mg/kg WEZENLA will be given by your doctor through a drip in a vein in your arm (intravenous infusion). After the starting dose, you will receive the next dose of 90 mg WEZENLA after 8 weeks, then every 12 weeks thereafter by an injection under the skin ('subcutaneously').
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text: In some patients, after the first injection under the skin, 90 mg WEZENLA may be given every 8 weeks. Your doctor will decide when you should receive your next dose.
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: section_header
blocks.text: How WEZENLA is given
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text: WEZENLA is given as an injection under the skin ('subcutaneously'). At the start of your treatment, medical or nursing staff may inject WEZENLA.
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text: However, you and your doctor may decide that you may inject WEZENLA yourself. In this case you will receive training on how to inject WEZENLA yourself.
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text: For instructions on how to inject WEZENLA, see 'Instructions for use' at the end of this leaflet. Talk to your doctor if you have any questions about giving yourself an injection.
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: section_header
blocks.text: If you use more WEZENLA than you should
section_path: If you use more WEZENLA than you should
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: If you have used or been given too much WEZENLA, talk to a doctor or pharmacist straight away. Always have the outer carton of the medicine with you, even if it is empty.
section_path: If you use more WEZENLA than you should
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: section_header
blocks.text: If you forget to use WEZENLA
section_path: If you forget to use WEZENLA
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: If you forget a dose, contact your doctor or pharmacist. Do not take a double dose to make up for a forgotten dose.
section_path: If you forget to use WEZENLA
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: section_header
blocks.text: If you stop using WEZENLA
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: It is not dangerous to stop using WEZENLA. However, if you stop, your symptoms may come back.
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: If you have any further questions on the use of this medicine, ask your doctor or pharmacist.
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: section_header
blocks.text: 4. Possible side effects
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: Like all medicines, this medicine can cause side effects, although not everybody gets them.
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: section_header
blocks.text: Serious side effects
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: Some patients may have serious side effects that may need urgent treatment.
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: section_header
blocks.text: Allergic reactions - these may need urgent treatment. Tell your doctor or get emergency medical help straight away if you notice any of the following signs.
section_path: Allergic reactions - these may need urgent treatment. Tell your doctor or get emergency medical help straight away if you notice any of the following signs.
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text: Serious allergic reactions ('anaphylaxis') are rare in people taking ustekinumab (may affect up to 1 in 1 000 people). Signs include:
section_path: Allergic reactions - these may need urgent treatment. Tell your doctor or get emergency medical help straight away if you notice any of the following signs.
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text: difficulty breathing or swallowing
section_path: Allergic reactions - these may need urgent treatment. Tell your doctor or get emergency medical help straight away if you notice any of the following signs.
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text: low blood pressure, which can cause dizziness or light-headedness
section_path: Allergic reactions - these may need urgent treatment. Tell your doctor or get emergency medical help straight away if you notice any of the following signs.
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text: swelling of the face, lips, mouth or throat.
section_path: Allergic reactions - these may need urgent treatment. Tell your doctor or get emergency medical help straight away if you notice any of the following signs.
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text: Common signs of an allergic reaction include skin rash and hives (these may affect up to 1 in 100 people).
section_path: Allergic reactions - these may need urgent treatment. Tell your doctor or get emergency medical help straight away if you notice any of the following signs.
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: In rare cases, allergic lung reactions and lung inflammation have been reported in patients who receive ustekinumab. Tell your doctor right away if you develop symptoms such as cough, shortness of breath, and fever.
section_path: Allergic reactions - these may need urgent treatment. Tell your doctor or get emergency medical help straight away if you notice any of the following signs.
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: If you have a serious allergic reaction, your doctor may decide that you should not use WEZENLA again.
section_path: Allergic reactions - these may need urgent treatment. Tell your doctor or get emergency medical help straight away if you notice any of the following signs.
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: section_header
blocks.text: Infections - these may need urgent treatment. Tell your doctor straight away if you notice any of the following signs.
section_path: Infections - these may need urgent treatment. Tell your doctor straight away if you notice any of the following signs.
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text: Infections of the nose or throat and common cold are common (may affect up to 1 in 10 people)
section_path: Infections - these may need urgent treatment. Tell your doctor straight away if you notice any of the following signs.
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text: Infections of the chest are uncommon (may affect up to 1 in 100 people)
section_path: Infections - these may need urgent treatment. Tell your doctor straight away if you notice any of the following signs.
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text: Inflammation of tissue under the skin ('cellulitis') is uncommon (may affect up to 1 in 100 people)
section_path: Infections - these may need urgent treatment. Tell your doctor straight away if you notice any of the following signs.
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text: Shingles (a type of painful rash with blisters) are uncommon (may affect up to 1 in 100 people)
section_path: Infections - these may need urgent treatment. Tell your doctor straight away if you notice any of the following signs.
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: WEZENLA may make you less able to fight infections. Some infections could become serious and may include infections caused by viruses, fungi, bacteria (including tuberculosis), or parasites, including infections that mainly occur in people with a weakened immune system (opportunistic infections). Opportunistic infections of the brain (encephalitis, meningitis), lungs, and eye have been reported in patients receiving treatment with ustekinumab.
section_path: Infections - these may need urgent treatment. Tell your doctor straight away if you notice any of the following signs.
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: You must look out for signs of infection while you are using WEZENLA. These include:
section_path: Infections - these may need urgent treatment. Tell your doctor straight away if you notice any of the following signs.
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text: fever, flu-like symptoms, night sweats, weight loss
section_path: Infections - these may need urgent treatment. Tell your doctor straight away if you notice any of the following signs.
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text: feeling tired or short of breath; cough which will not go away
section_path: Infections - these may need urgent treatment. Tell your doctor straight away if you notice any of the following signs.
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text: warm, red and painful skin, or a painful skin rash with blisters
section_path: Infections - these may need urgent treatment. Tell your doctor straight away if you notice any of the following signs.
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text: burning when passing water
section_path: Infections - these may need urgent treatment. Tell your doctor straight away if you notice any of the following signs.
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text: diarrhoea
section_path: Infections - these may need urgent treatment. Tell your doctor straight away if you notice any of the following signs.
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text: visual disturbance or vision loss
section_path: Infections - these may need urgent treatment. Tell your doctor straight away if you notice any of the following signs.
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text: headache, neck stiffness, light sensitivity, nausea or confusion.
section_path: Infections - these may need urgent treatment. Tell your doctor straight away if you notice any of the following signs.
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: Tell your doctor straight away if you notice any of these signs of infection. These may be signs of infections such as chest infections, skin infections, shingles or opportunistic infections that could have serious complications. Tell your doctor if you have any kind of infection that will not go away or keeps coming back. Your doctor may decide that you should not use WEZENLA until the infection goes away. Also tell your doctor if you have any open cuts or sores as they might get infected.
section_path: Infections - these may need urgent treatment. Tell your doctor straight away if you notice any of the following signs.
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: Shedding of skin - increase in redness and shedding of skin over a larger area of the body may be symptoms of erythrodermic psoriasis or exfoliative dermatitis, which are serious skin conditions. You should tell your doctor straight away if you notice any of these signs.
section_path: Infections - these may need urgent treatment. Tell your doctor straight away if you notice any of the following signs.
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: section_header
blocks.text: 5. How to store WEZENLA
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text: Keep this medicine out of the sight and reach of children.
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text: Store in a refrigerator (2°C-8°C). Do not freeze.
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text: Keep the pre-filled pen in the outer carton in order to protect from light.
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text: If needed, individual WEZENLA pre-filled pens may also be stored at room temperature up to 30°C for a maximum single period of up to 30 days in the original carton in order to protect from light. Record the date when the pre-filled pen is first removed from the refrigerator and the discard date. The discard date must not exceed the original expiry date printed on the carton. Once a pre-filled pen has been stored at room temperature (up to 30°C), it should not be returned to the refrigerator. Discard the pre-filled pen if not used within 30 days at room temperature storage or by the original expiry date, whichever is earlier.
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text: Do not shake the WEZENLA pre-filled pens. Prolonged vigorous shaking may damage the medicine.
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: section_header
blocks.text: Do not use this medicine:
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text: After the expiry date which is stated on the label and the carton after 'EXP'. The expiry date refers to the last day of that month.
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text: If the liquid is discoloured, cloudy or you can see foreign particles floating in it (see section 6 'What WEZENLA looks like and contents of the pack').
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text: If you know, or think that it may have been exposed to extreme temperatures (such as accidentally frozen or heated).
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text: If the product has been shaken vigorously.
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: WEZENLA is for single use only. Any unused product remaining in the pre-filled pen should be thrown away. Do not throw away any medicines via wastewater or household waste. Ask your pharmacist how to throw away medicines you no longer use. These measures will help protect the environment.
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: section_header
blocks.text: Dosing:
section_path: 6. Contents of the pack and other information
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text: WEZENLA comes in two different doses: 45 mg/0.5 mL and 90 mg/1.0 mL. Check the prescription to make sure you have the correct dose.
section_path: 6. Contents of the pack and other information
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text: The label colour and window size of the pre-filled pen will be different for each dose. The amount of medicine in the pre-filled pen will also be different for each dose.
section_path: 6. Contents of the pack and other information
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.caption: 45 mg/0.5 mL
section_path: 6. Contents of the pack and other information
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: caption
blocks.text: 45 mg/0.5 mL
section_path: 6. Contents of the pack and other information
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: caption
blocks.text: 90 mg/1.0 mL
section_path: 6. Contents of the pack and other information
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: section_header
blocks.text: Important:
section_path: 6. Contents of the pack and other information
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text: If the dose is 90 mg, you will receive either one 90 mg pre-filled pen or two 45 mg pre-filled pens.
section_path: 6. Contents of the pack and other information
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text: If you receive two 45 mg pre-filled pens for a 90 mg dose, you will need to give a second injection straight after the first.
section_path: 6. Contents of the pack and other information
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text: Repeat steps 1-14 for the second injection using a new pre-filled pen.
section_path: 6. Contents of the pack and other information
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text: Choose a different site for the second injection.
section_path: 6. Contents of the pack and other information
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: section_header
blocks.text: Using your WEZENLA pre-filled pen:
section_path: 6. Contents of the pack and other information
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text: It is important that you or your caregiver do not try to perform the injection unless you have received training from your doctor or healthcare provider.
section_path: 6. Contents of the pack and other information
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text: Do not use the pre-filled pen if the carton is damaged or the seal is broken.
section_path: 6. Contents of the pack and other information
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text: Do not use the pre-filled pen after the expiry date on the label.
section_path: 6. Contents of the pack and other information
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text: Do not shake the pre-filled pen.
section_path: 6. Contents of the pack and other information
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text: Do not remove the cap from the pre-filled pen until you are ready to inject.
section_path: 6. Contents of the pack and other information
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text: Do not use the pre-filled pen if it has been frozen.
section_path: 6. Contents of the pack and other information
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text: Do not use the pre-filled pen if it has been dropped on a hard surface. Part of the pre-filled pen may be broken even if you cannot see the break. If available, use a new pre-filled pen and call your doctor or healthcare provider.
section_path: 6. Contents of the pack and other information
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: Important: Keep the pre-filled pen and sharps disposal container out of the sight and reach of children.
section_path: 6. Contents of the pack and other information
blocks.speaker: label
